label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Tiger's $1 Billion Tech League
items.text: Tiger Woods co-founded TGL, a tech-forward indoor team golf league valued near $1 billion as his DUI case ends with a five-year license suspension.

items.headline: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Declared
items.text: LIV Golf declared bankruptcy to facilitate a new tour version but faces financial turmoil after PIF funding was withdrawn in April.

items.headline: Koepka's Return Disappoints
items.text: Brooks Koepka finished 94th in FedEx Cup standings in 2026, failing to contend in majors and facing pressure to regain top form in 2027.
